sections.heading: Skills
sections.text:
Basic Attack
 WILDLANDS HUNTRESS

sections.heading: BASIC ATTACK:
sections.text: Typhoeus can perform up to 5 basic attack sequences, dealing Nature DMG to enemies. When performing a finisher on an enemy, Typhoeus deals massive Nature DMG and restores some SP.

sections.heading: FINISHER:
sections.text:
Battle Skill
 PIERCING ARROWS OF THE WOODS

 Jumps to enter a Hovering status, during which Typhoeus can unleash 5 Aerial Basic Attacks that deal Nature DMG , consuming the target's Nature Infliction stacks to accumulate Signs for herself. She can also consume Hunting Arrows to enhance her attacks, dealing additional Nature Burst DMG.

 Combo Skill
 RAMPANT THORNS

 Transmutes all accumulated Signs to Hunting Arrows and creates a Barrage Array at the enemy location, dealing continuous Nature DMG and applying Slow on enemies within the AOE while increasing the Nature Burst DMG they take.

 Trigger: When Typhoeus reaches max Signs.

 Ultimate
 CALL OF ICE MOUNTAIN

 Fires an Imbued Arrow that explodes after hitting the enemy, dealing massive Nature DMG to enemies within the AOE. Typhoeus then immediately enters a Hovering status and each of her next 5 Aerial Basic Attacks triggers a Hail of Arrows where the attack lands, dealing additional massive DMG.
